'''Malin din Toral Breaking Wave''' is a [[Sea Folk]] [[Wavemistress]] of Clan Somarin. She is [[Sailmistress]] of ''[[Windrunner]]''.

== Appearance ==
She has gray streaked hair and a grave face. She has five rings in each ear, with one of them being connected to her nose.

== Activities ==
She greets [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]] when they come aboard ''Windrunner'' and is present when they bargain with [[Nesta din Reas Two Moons]] over the [[Bowl of the Winds]].
